text:
jordana: Heads-up — finalizing the webinar pricing demo flow. Need the micro-FAQ + calc UX done by Thursday so Growth can stage the leads page.

rachel: Key asks from comms: 1) avoid 'Starter' label; 2) show annual savings inline; 3) short FAQ + 'what reserved means' tooltip.

tom: For the A/B, propose these pairings: Variant A: 'Developer | Teams | Dedicated'  Variant B: 'Individual | Team | Dedicated Node'. Keep two variants only.

samir: Product prefers short, explicit names. Also adding a 'commit slider' that changes per-seat price; default set to 'No commitment'. Will add a small help text: 'Commit = reserved capacity with discount'.

li: Draft FAQ (will refine):
- Q: How do you calculate estimates?
- A: We multiply avg tokens per call by calls/day, then show monthly/annual.

- Q: What is caching/quantization impact?
- A: Caching reduces repeat prefix compute; quantization reduces model size. Both lower cost; calc will show a 'Caching ON/OFF' toggle with delta.

evan: Analytics asks: instrument events: pricing_page.view, calc.adjust, calc.variant, signup.with_tier. Also record 'tooltip.opened'. We'll need a dashboard slice for webinar cohort.

chris: Ops note — routing rule: if utm_campaign == 'pricing_launch_webinar' then tag lead 'pricing-webinar'; if selected_tier contains 'Dedicated' or commit > 0 -> route to Enterprise SDRs + notify CSMs. Sample webhook:```
POST /webhooks/lead-route
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "campaign": "pricing_launch_webinar",
  "tier": "Dedicated",
  "commit_months": 12,
  "email": "..."
}
```

ops-bot: Reminder: content freeze at 4532080000. Any URL/redirect changes must be approved 48h prior.

rachel: Benchmark narrative idea: show live numbers for 'Caching OFF' vs 'Caching ON' using a demo workload — emphasize % token reduction and $/1M tokens equivalent. Keep slides with exact numbers sourced from runtime bench.

jordana: Action items: li -> full micro-FAQ + 1-line tooltips by EOD; samir -> implement A/B names + commit slider + caching toggle; evan -> events + dashboard; chris -> create INF-5501 webhook + routing; rachel -> finalize webinar narrative and slide snippets; tom -> run small UX test on mobile for tooltip reachability.

samir: I'll add a 'compare row' showing cost with 'prefix-cache' and 'no-cache' and a small note: 'results depend on workload; shown for illustrative demo'.

li: Posting copy in ~2h. Tone: concise, developer-facing, no marketing fluff.

rachel: FYI I'm writing two social lead-in headlines: one angle focused on 'predictable costs' and another on 'performance at scale' — we'll test in the campaign.

jordana: Great. If anything blocks the freeze tag @ops-bot and cc me. MKT ticket MKT-2202 created for follow-ups. :rocket:
